data.long_meaning: One who is free from the knowledge of sin, guiltless, innocent, truthful, sincere. The name Masoom carries the meaning “Innocent, Truthful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Masoom usually hope their child will grow to embody innocent, truthful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Masoom belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Innocent, Truthful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masoom total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مَسُوم
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَسُومَ مشتق از مَسَمَ يَمْسُمُ مَسْماً و مَسوماً، بمعنى بى‌نشان و بى‌اثر. در اصل به كسى گفته مى‌شود كه از گناه و خطا به دور است و هيچ‌كدام از گناهان كبيره را انجام نمى‌دهد. از اسماء حسناى الهى است و براى كسى كه از گناهان بزرگ دور بوده و به معصوميت نزديك باشد، استعمال مى‌شود.

in_urdu.name: معصوم
in_urdu.meaning: بے گناہ، بے داغ، معصوم، پاکیزہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: معصوم کی اصطلاح عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے گناہ سے پاک یا بے داغ۔ یہ نام ان بچوں کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو بے گناہ اور پاکیزہ دل کے حامل ہوتے ہیں۔ اسلامی عقیدے میں، معصومیت ایک اہم فضیلت ہے جس کی پیروی کرنا ضروری ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मासूम

in_english.name: Masoom
in_english.long_meaning: The name Masoom originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the term 'ma'sūm', which means 'protected' or 'sinless'. In Islamic tradition, it refers to someone who is free from major sins and is considered innocent or pure. This name symbolizes a person with a virtuous and unblemished character, reflecting ideals of moral integrity and spiritual cleanliness.
